anchor: Which sixth-level magic lets me and five friends snap over to a temple I marked earlier, but does nothing if I never marked one?
My whole group is standing close together and needs to get back to our marked home base in one action. What magic does that?
Which small beast has a 30-foot climb speed, a bite doing 1d4 plus 3 piercing damage, and only 9 hit points?
Which nimble beast with a 40-foot walking speed sees in the dark out to 60 feet and has a challenge rating of one-eighth?
Is there a common item that is a small jelly-like bead melting on your tongue to feed you for one full day?
Can I carry one small common item that replaces a whole day of meals, so I don't have to pack food?
Which top-tier spell has a one-in-three chance of permanently locking me out of it after I use it for something other than copying another spell?
After I cast a high-level spell for a creative effect, my muscles go weak for days and my spells deal life-draining harm until I finish a long rest. What's the cost?
Which large sea-dwelling creature can only breathe underwater and can ram harder after charging twenty feet straight at a foe?
What big aquatic animal with only 5 feet of land speed dashes through the water on its turn without drawing free attacks?
Which undead creature turns into mist when knocked to zero hit points away from its resting place and must return within two hours?
Which lawful evil undead resists life-draining harm, scales ceilings, and can turn failed saves into successes three times a day?
Which 10-gold, 8-pound tool set lets me chip a symbol or hole into stone on a DC 10 check and is used with Strength?
What set of tools for stonework uses my Strength and pairs with a block and tackle for hauling?
Which feat gives me two minor spells from the cleric, druid, or wizard lists plus one first-level spell I can cast for free once per rest?
I want a starting feat that lets me swap one of my minor spells whenever I level up and can be taken more than once. What is it?
At level 18, if my muscle check total comes up lower than my raw physical power number, can I use that number instead?
My rage-driven character rolled poorly to resist being knocked over by a giant at level 18. Does any feature let me use my raw power instead?
Which huge primate-like beast punches twice a turn and hurls a boulder up to 90 feet, knocking Large or smaller foes prone?
What huge creature can leap 30 feet by spending 10 feet of its movement, and has 168 hit points?
Which rug can hover and fly at up to 80 feet when I speak its command word, but slows if it carries more than its normal load?
If a random roll gives me the largest flying rug, what's its normal carrying capacity, and what happens to its speed beyond that?
Which fourth-level spell lets me take mental control of a wild animal for up to a minute, giving it orders through a telepathic link?
If my mind-controlled animal takes damage, does it get another try to shake off my grip?
Which second-level spell soothes a group of humanoids in a 20-foot circle, making them unafraid or indifferent to creatures I pick?
Can a spell make a crowd immune to being scared or enchanted for a minute, or make them stop being unfriendly to my allies?
Which large flying monster attaches to a victim, blinds it, and splits damage it takes between itself and the victim?
Which monster's attacks grow weaker in glaring light and whose tail hits reach 10 feet?
What wrist gear makes me skilled with long-range and short-range bows and adds two damage to hits with them?
Which wrist equipment needs me to bond with it before I get extra bow damage?
Which very rare liquid coats one blade or twenty arrows, turning nonmagical slashing or piercing weapons into +3 ones?
How long does it take to smear a substance on a plain cutting or piercing weapon so it becomes a +3 weapon?
Which top-tier jewelry cancels incantations of level 7 or lower and can fling a single-target one back at its caster?
If a magical effect aimed only at me is resisted, can I redirect it to its sender while wearing jewelry of the highest rarity?
Which lawful evil fey soldier gets an edge on attacks against foes near its teammates and coats its arrows with toxin?
Which fey brute with 11 hit points and armor class 18 swings a longsword and carries a shield?
Which earth-born winged monster swoops out of melee reach without drawing free attacks and flies at 60 feet?
Which chaotic evil flier shrugs off toxins and cannot be turned to stone or left exhausted?
Which tiny black orb can be hurled 60 feet, blasts creatures for 5d4 damage, and traps those who fail a Dexterity roll inside a clear barrier for a minute?
Which marble-sized one-ounce pellet creates a see-through cage around creatures, and how long does it last?
Which second-level spell lets me give one creature a short instruction of up to 25 words, which it follows for eight hours unless I or my allies harm it?
Can I plant a doable request in a listener's head using a drop of honey as a component, making them obey until someone hurts them?
Which first-level protective magic makes a willing creature with no protective gear have a base defense of 13 plus Dexterity for eight hours?
What's a touch-cast effect requiring a tanned hide component that ends early if the target puts on a protective layer?
Which fourth-level ritual lets me ask a deity or its messenger one question about events in the next week, though the answer may be cryptic?
If I perform the same ritual twice before a long rest, what's the chance the second attempt brings silence?
At level 14, which wilderness ability costs a Wild Shape use to conjure a 15-foot block of phantom trees and vines that gives my team half cover?
How can I slide a magical overgrowth block up to 60 feet using a quick action, and what shelter does it give my allies inside?
Which martial class gets a single burst of extra action at level 2, and what is its proficiency bonus at that level?
Once a martial character hits level 11 and attacks three times per turn, how many weapon mastery picks does it know?
Which entertainer tradition gathers secrets from scholarly books and folk tales, meeting at universities and festivals to expose lies?
Which performers would gather in libraries to share knowledge and then mock self-important officials at festivals?
Which fifth-level spell forces a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend to serve me for a full day?
Which spell costs a gem worth over 1,000 gold and takes an hour to cast, letting me command a fiend for a day?
Which 25-gold, 3-pound kit lets me use makeup, checked against Charisma with DC 10, to change my look?
I want to pass as someone else at a masquerade. What 25-gold set of supplies would help me build an outfit?
A patron-bound spellcaster adds spells to its list as it levels up; which ability score powers those spells?
Can I swap one spell on my list for another whenever I level up, and can an arcane focus serve as my focus?
On my turn, which action type do I use to cast a one-action spell or activate a charged enchanted item?
If a minute-long incantation gets interrupted and I lose my focus, does my spell slot get used up?
Which neutral humanoid gains an edge on attacks and rolls to resist once it is below half health, and swings a large axe?
Which neutral humanoid has 67 hit points and a Strength score of 16, wearing hide armor?
Which small humanoid folk see in the dark out to 60 feet and get an edge on rolls to resist mental and personality-based effects?
Which small people can cast a minor illusion trick and speak with animals without spending a spell slot, as many times as my proficiency bonus allows?
Which cheap cantrip makes an object I touch glow for an hour, shining a 20-foot circle with dimmer light beyond?
What hides the glow of an enchanted object, and does casting it again end the glow?
Which large celestial cannot be spied on by magic or have its thoughts read without permission, and keeps its true motives hard to read?
Which celestial's mind-tearing shriek hits every enemy within 300 feet and leaves them unable to act until its next turn?
Which piece of worn jewelry holds three charges and lets me flip a failed agility roll into a success by spending one?
If I'm wearing worn jewelry and fail a nimbleness-based roll, can I spend a charge to avoid it, and how often do charges come back?
What third-level protective magic hides a touched target from fortune-telling and remote-viewing for eight hours?
To keep my hideout out of a seer's sight, what 25-gold dust do I need, and how large a place can it cover?
Which celestial archer's ranged shot kills any foe with 100 or fewer hit points within 600 feet unless it passes a DC 21 dodge roll?
Which celestial being can blind a foe within 120 feet with a stare and then warp in a burst of holy light?
At level 3, which choice lets my tracker-type character pick a specialty path that adds features at certain levels?
I'm a wilderness scout and want features that grow with my level; when do I pick my specialty and do I keep getting its features?
Which uncommon stoppered container puffs out a thick cloud that spreads 10 feet per minute up to 120 feet, blocking sight?
What breeze or magical gale clears a sealed fog cloud after one minute, and how long does it hang there if I leave it sealed?
Can I transfer a magical written incantation from a rolled-up parchment into my own private tome, and what roll decides it?
If I try copying a rolled-up parchment's incantation into my tome and fail, does the parchment survive?
